entry.title: LibreOffice: Out-of-bounds read in HWP picture import
entry.summary: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. An out-of-bounds read existed when the link target of a crafted picture was read, so memory past the picture data could end up in the converted document. In fixed versions the link target is taken… (Vulnerability - Document Fdn. (CNA); AI attribution as credited in the CVE record; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.summary: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features option is enabled, LibreOffice offers to migrate such a database to the embedded Firebird engine when the document is opened. A heap buffer overflow existed when binary values were copied during the… (Vulnerability - Document Fdn. (CNA); AI attribution as credited in the CVE record; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: LibreOffice: Out-of-bounds read in UTF-16 text and DIF spreadsheet import
entry.summary: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF-16 encoding. Both are read one line at a time. An out-of-bounds read existed when a line of a crafted file was read, because the length of the line could be miscalculated, so memory beyond the line… (Vulnerability - Document Fdn. (CNA); AI attribution as credited in the CVE record; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.summary: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows whether each signature is valid. An out-of-bounds write existed when a signature was checked, because the parts of the file that a crafted signature claims to cover were not checked against the size… (Vulnerability - Document Fdn. entry.title: Apache Shiro: Saved form replay may weaken cookie security and expose form data
entry.summary: When Apache Shiro is used with the Jakarta EE integration module, the automatic form saving feature weakens the security of a form that is resubmitted after login. Cookies set by the application during the resubmission could lose their security attributes, such as `Secure` and `SameSite`. In… (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: LibreOffice: Base document events run macros without the macro security check
entry.summary: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. The macro security setting decides whether macros that come with a document may run. Macros bound to the events of a Base document were run without the macro security setting being applied, so… (Vulnerability - Document Fdn. (CNA); AI attribution as credited in the CVE record; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Apache Shiro: Authorization annotations not always enforced, depending on where they are placed
entry.summary: Authorization annotations, such as @RequiresRoles and @RequiresPermissions, are not always enforced in some class or interface hierarchies. Annotations declared on an interface were not enforced when using the shiro-guice, shiro-aspectj, shiro-cdi or shiro-jakarta-ee modules. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.summary: When PropertiesRealm reloads its properties file, removed users and narrowed permissions could remain in effect. This issue affects all Apache Shiro versions through 3.0.1, only when PropertiesRealm`loads its properties from a file, which is reloaded periodically by default. The script let the shell interpret the name of the document's file, so a file with a… (Vulnerability - Document Fdn. (CNA); AI attribution as credited in the CVE record; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Apache Shiro: DefaultLdapRealm accepts any password when authentication caching is enabled
entry.summary: When authentication caching is enabled on DefaultLdapRealm, after a user logs in successfully once, subsequent logins for that user succeed with any password. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-15)

entry.title: MIT krb5 kadmind XDR decoding permits authenticated memory exhaustion
entry.summary: In the RPCSEC_GSS unwrap path, attacker-controlled XDR length values can trigger large allocations before MIC verification; some decode-failure paths also leave allocations unreleased. A valid RPCSEC_GSS security context and access to a service using this path are required. Repeated requests can… (Vulnerability - AISLE / Red Hat Product Security; announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: HarfBuzz avar2 breakpoint processing can amplify subset CPU work
entry.summary: avar2 subsetting processes breakpoints quadratically during offset compensation. The maintainer reports a 131 KB font taking 42 seconds of CPU, with work repeated on serializer retries. (Vulnerability - Anthropic / HarfBuzz maintainers; announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: HarfBuzz avar2 zero-width variation rows can amplify subset memory
entry.summary: A small font with many avar breakpoints and a 65,535-row region-less VarData caused dense tuple allocation; the maintainer reports a 20 KB input reaching 2.8 GB peak memory. (Vulnerability - Anthropic / HarfBuzz maintainers; announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: HarfBuzz contextual-class subset traversal can amplify CPU work
entry.summary: ContextFormat2/ChainContextFormat2 subset closure and dependency traversal repeatedly walked a large ClassDef for many classes sharing it, causing quadratic work. Maintainer fix computes intersecting classes once and adds a regression font. (Vulnerability - Anthropic / HarfBuzz maintainers; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: HarfBuzz aliased gvar offsets can amplify avar2 subset resources
entry.summary: Malformed overlapping gvar offsets let many glyphs refer to one block; avar2 subsetting parsed, rewrote and retained a heap copy per glyph and retried. The maintainer reports a 251 KB input reaching 1.3 GiB and 26 seconds CPU. (Vulnerability - Anthropic / HarfBuzz maintainers; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Cockpit: cockpit: denial of service via unbounded fragmented websocket messages
entry.summary: A flaw was found in Cockpit. This vulnerability allows a remote attacker, without prior authentication, to send specially crafted fragmented WebSocket messages. These messages accumulate without a total-size limit, leading to unbounded memory exhaustion and a denial of service in the `cockpit-ws`… (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-10)

entry.summary: Before a shadow server reaches the authenticated active-session state, its Fast-Path input handlers forward mouse, keyboard and synchronization events to the X11 backend without the state guard used by the slow-path handlers. A network client can negotiate TLS-only RDP and send Fast-Path input… (Vulnerability - FreeRDP maintainers / reporter; announced 2026-11-09)

Attackers can supply a crafted H.264 stream with a display orientation SEI message followed by payload… (Vulnerability - VulnCheck (CNA); AI attribution as credited in the CVE record; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: Apache Commons Codec: Apache Commons Codec: NUL bytes in tree entry names cause Git/SWHID identifier collisions (GitIdentifiers class)
entry.summary: The GitIdentifiers class in Apache Commons Codec did not reject NUL bytes in tree entry names. Because Git uses a NUL byte to mark the end of each entry name in a tree object, a crafted name could make one tree serialize to the same bytes as a different tree. Two different directory trees could… (Vulnerability - apache (CNA); AI attribution as credited in the CVE record; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.summary: Apache Commons Codec's Blake3 class documented the output of its doFinalize methods as depending on any previously finalized bytes, so that consecutive calls would return different output. entry.summary: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.2 and later allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by sending repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

Remote attackers can cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in kadmind) by accumulating a large number of AUTH_GSSAPI… (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)

entry.title: Krb5: mit krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak dos via gss-rpc auth flavor switching
entry.summary: The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and later does not release the previous authentication context when a client switches from an RPCSEC_GSS or AUTH_GSSAPI flavor to a non-GSS flavor on the same TCP connection. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-09)
